name: SHiP
summary: SHiP is a selected future project proposed for the High-Intensity ECN3 / Beam Dump Facility in the CERN SPS North Area, dedicated to hidden particles and light dark matter.
detection_principle: A high-intensity proton beam strikes a thick target to produce weakly coupled particles. Behind a muon shield, a visible-decay spectrometer and scattering detector seek long-lived-particle decays and dark-matter recoils respectively.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
